ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ,2008 betweenRICHARDE.KIRNandFRANCISMcGUIRE,eachofwhomisaNewYork resident having a residence address at 155 Lexington Avenue, NewYork, New York 10016 (collectively,“Owner")and132EAST 30thSTREET CORPORATION,aNewYork cooperative corporation having its principal office c/o Nari Pohani, 146 West 29"h Street, New York,NewYork 10001 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Owner is the ownerinfee title of certainland,with thebuildings and improvements thereon,known as 155 Lexington Avenue,NewYork,NewYork, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the“Tax Map") as Block 885, herein called"Owner's Land," said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof or any additions or alterations thereto sometimes being referred to hereinafter collectively as "Owner's Building")(Owner's Land and Owner's Building, collectively,“Owner's Property"). B. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land located at 132 East 30"h Street, NewYork,NewYork,and identified on theTax Map as Block 885,Lot 61,which is more particularly described inSchedule"B" annexed hereto (said land being herein called 'Developer's Land" (said land, together with the buildings and improvements thereon, and any replacements thereof or any additions or alterations thereto, sometimes being referred to hereinafter collectively as“Developer's Property"). The parcels comprising Owner's Land and Developer's Land are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the"Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel." C. Owner's Land and Developer's Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance in excess of 10linearfeet; D.Developer intends to construct a new building on Developer's Land (the “New Building"), to replace an existing building on such land, which will contain more Development Rights (defined hereafter) than would be permitted on Developer's Land if considered as a single Zoning Lot (hereafter defined) under the Zoning Resolution (hereafter defined); E. To enable Developer to construct the New Building, Owner and Developer wish to takeadvantageoftheprocedure authorizedby theZoningResolutionthatpermitsthemto merge their separate tax lots into a single Zoning Lot (the“Combined Zoning Lot") and inter alia to effectuate the transfer of Development Rights from Owner's Land toDeveloper's Land; F.  To achieve these objectives, Owner and Developer wish to enter into this Agreement for the purpose of establishing and setting forth the rights and obligations of the Parties (hereafter defined) to this Agreement with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. 1NY239,125,575v510-1-08109659.010100
